verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks that a programmatic consumer can receive. You set up a webhook of a given type (e.g. `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`) and read typed fields from the payload. Every delivery carries a `webhook-id` header to use as an idempotency key, and webhook signing is available as a per-account opt-in. missing for 10: a documented catalogue of subscribable event types beyond WORKFLOW_COMPLETED, explicit registration mechanics (API endpoint or UI steps), retry/delivery-guarantee policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
